$comment: Mafia module language packs. One folder per locale. Each locale ships ui.json (interface strings) and bot_players.json (filler-player nicknames + speech). Key sets MUST be identical across locales - enforced by a parity test.

conventions.plurals: value may be an object keyed by CLDR category: one/few/many/other. Resolver: en+es use one/other, ru uses one/few/many/other, zh uses other only
conventions.buttons: keep button labels under 24 chars; emoji prefix allowed
conventions.formatting: plain text here; parse_mode=HTML applied by renderer, user data always escaped
